executive-secretary-full-mock-5.stem: Gasanze Cell received and resolved citizens' complaints as follows: 2017-2018: received 23,456, resolved 15,541; 2018-2019: received 14,578, resolved 13,312; 2019-2020: received 8,000, resolved 7,790; 2020-2021: received 4,325, resolved 4,225.
